profile.reading:
This is Digital Realty facility EWR20, at 100 Delawanna Avenue, Clifton, NJ 07014. Digital Realty's own property listing confirms this address as EWR20, but this session's fetch did not return a confirmed square footage figure for it specifically.

Digital Realty Trust (NYSE: DLR, SEC CIK 1297996), headquartered at 2323 Bryan Street, Dallas, Texas, reported 310 data centers worldwide as of December 31, 2025, 221 wholly owned or consolidated and 89 in unconsolidated joint ventures, about 57.6 million rentable square feet across more than 55 metro markets including 118 US facilities, per its FY2025 Form 10-K filed with the SEC. The company operates as a colocation and wholesale landlord rather than running its own compute, distinguishing it from hyperscaler tenants such as AWS, Google, or Meta, also tracked in this registry.

This building is part of Digital Realty's New York/New Jersey metro footprint, which spans historic Manhattan carrier hotels and a cluster of suburban New Jersey buildings in Clifton and Piscataway Township, coded EWR10 through EWR21 on the company's own metro listing. Digital Realty markets these properties under its PlatformDIGITAL brand, positioning the metro alongside Northern Virginia, Chicago, Dallas, and Silicon Valley, all tracked elsewhere in this registry, as core hubs in its global interconnection and colocation platform. PSE&G serves most of the northern New Jersey data center market.

Digital Realty's FY2025 Form 10-K identifies the United States as its largest single national market by both facility count and rentable square footage, discloses portfolio metrics by region and metro rather than by individual building, and this pattern is consistent across every Digital Realty property researched by this registry this session, not specific to this entry.

reading.body:
EWR20 is a 183,000 square foot colocation building in Clifton, New Jersey, operated by Digital Realty as part of its New York/New Jersey metro hub. Digital Reality does not publish IT capacity, power density, or year-opened data on this facility's spec page or in its 10-K filing. The building holds SOC 2, SOC 3, PCI DSS, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 27001 certifications, qualifying it to host regulated financial services and critical infrastructure workloads.

New Jersey has 48 mapped data center facilities on record in this registry, but only 5 publish megawatt capacity figures. EWR20 does not publish a power figure, so its rank and contribution to the state's 111.3 MW of published capacity cannot be determined from available sources. The facility sits in the northern New Jersey cluster served by PSE&G, alongside other Digital Realty buildings coded EWR10 through EWR21 in Clifton and Piscataway Township, a market where New York and New Jersey have increased regulatory scrutiny of large-load data center siting and grid interconnection.

Without published IT load, year of operation, or power density, this building cannot be assessed for its significance to AI scaling or the state's compute growth. Its 183,000 square feet and colocation classification indicate it hosts customer workloads rather than hyperscaler operations, but the specific tenant mix, current utilization, and grid capacity are not public.
